content: André Jean René Lacrampe was a French Roman Catholic bishop. He was born on November 21, 1941, in Oloron-Sainte-Marie, France. Lacrampe was ordained a priest on June 29, 1968. He served as the Bishop of Ajaccio, Corsica, from 1987 to 1995, and then as the Bishop of воды, France, from 1995 to 2011. He was also the Archbishop of Besançon from 2011 until his retirement in 2018.
